item.content:encoded: George Russell colocó a Mercedes en la pole position para la carrera sprint del Gran Premio de Países Bajos del sábado, por delante del McLaren de Lando Norris, vigente campeón del mundial de Fórmula Uno. Russell marcó una mejor vuelta de un minuto y 11,567 segundos, superando a su compatriota británico por 0,041 segundos. Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, saldrá tercero en la carrera del sábado, seguido por el McLaren de Oscar Piastri y el líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes. El héroe local, Max Verstappen, fue el sexto más rápido con Red Bull, y Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, el séptimo. El ganador de la carrera sprint se lleva ocho puntos, y los ocho primeros clasificados suman puntos para el campeonato.

item.title: Lavouras de trigo do RS sentem excesso de chuvas, mas Emater mantém estimativa de safra
item.description: As chuvas que atingem a safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul prejudicaram parte das lavouras do Estado, o principal produtor do Brasil nos últimos anos, mas a estimativa oficial da safra gaúcha não foi alterada, afirmou a Emater nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As chuvas que atingem a safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul prejudicaram parte das lavouras do Estado, o principal produtor do Brasil nos últimos anos, mas a estimativa oficial da safra gaúcha não foi alterada, afirmou a Emater nesta sexta-feira. "As lavouras de trigo apresentam desenvolvimento regular no Rio Grande do Sul, parcialmente prejudicado pelo excesso de precipitações, pela persistência de nebulosidade e pela baixa disponibilidade de radiação solar", afirmou o boletim semanal do órgão de assistência técnica vinculado ao governo gaúcho. "Apesar das limitações meteorológicas, o potencial produtivo permanece, em geral, satisfatório", declarou. A produção do Rio Grande do Sul foi estimada inicialmente em 2,2 milhões de toneladas, queda de 36,4% na comparação com a temporada anterior, com produtores reduzindo a área plantada, em parte por temerem os efeitos das chuvas associadas ao [USN:L1N42U0VD TEXT:"fenômeno climático El Niño"] no Sul do país. Com uma produção menor também no Paraná, outro importante Estado produtor, as importações de trigo pelo Brasil devem atingir patamares próximos de [USN:L1N44A11V TEXT:"recorde"] de mais de 7 milhões de toneladas em 2026/27 (agosto/setembro), segundo dados da estatal Conab. A elevada umidade no Rio Grande do Sul tem aumentado a pressão de doenças fúngicas, especialmente oídio, manchas foliares e ferrugens, que podem reduzir a qualidade e a produtividade. Além disso, eventuais chuvas na colheita também são danosas. "Nas áreas em floração, a elevada umidade do solo vem restringindo o trânsito de máquinas e reduzindo as janelas para a aplicação de fungicidas", acrescentou. Conforme o boletim semanal, as condições climáticas reduziram a taxa de crescimento e retardaram o desenvolvimento de parte das lavouras. A maioria das lavouras está em desenvolvimento vegetativo, representando 82% da área. As parcelas implantadas precocemente avançam para a floração, com 14%, e para o enchimento de grãos, com 4%, segundo a Emater.

item.title: U.S. Open tickets remain steep ahead of year's final Grand Slam
item.description: Fans hoping to catch some of the opening matches at the 2026 U.S. Open continue to face steep prices on the reseller market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Fans hoping to catch some of the opening matches at the 2026 U.S. Open continue to face steep prices on the reseller market. The get-in price for the first round at Flushing Meadows in New York, which gets underway on Aug. 30, sits at $197, according to TicketData.com. That spans all combined day and night sessions for the Round of 128, and is 33.1% higher than the final get-in price for first-round matches in 2025. How the withdrawal of men's No. 1-ranked player Jannik Sinner on Friday may impact that pricing remains to be seen, as the ticket prices for the entirety of the 2026 tournament are tracking closer to last year. The average get-in price for all 60 sessions as of mid-day Friday was $283, down 8.6% over the past week to sit just 0.7% above 2025. The get-in price for the women's and men's finals on Sept. 12 and Sept. 13 sits at an average of $534, up 19.0% from last year. However, the average price for the second round ($206) is down 27.0% from 2025, the third round ($266) is down 25.3% and the fourth round is ($266) is down 37.8%. While Sinner will not compete in this year's U.S. Open, No. 2-ranked Carlos Alcaraz announced he will return from the wrist injury that sidelined him from the French Open and Wimbledon. Serena Williams, who made her return to singles at Wimbledon, has yet to announce whether she will also play singles at the U.S. Open. However, there is speculation she will play with Alcaraz in the mixed doubles event that runs Aug. 24-26. --Field Level Media

item.title: ACE Robotics voit un "moment ChatGPT" pour les robots humanoïdes d'ici fin 2027
item.description: Les "cerveaux" des robots humanoïdes pourraient connaître d'ici à la fin de 2027 une percée comparable à celle qu'a représentée ChatGPT pour l'IA, a déclaré vendredi Wang Xiaogang, président de la start-up chinoise ACE Robotics.
item.dc:creator: Laurie Chen
item.content:encoded: Les "cerveaux" des robots humanoïdes pourraient connaître d'ici à la fin de 2027 une percée comparable à celle qu'a représentée ChatGPT pour l'IA, a déclaré vendredi Wang Xiaogang, président de la start-up chinoise ACE Robotics. "Nous pensons atteindre notre 'moment ChatGPT' grâce aux modèles du monde et à la collecte de données sur l'environnement", a-t-il déclaré à Reuters. "Même si nous atteignons ce point d'inflexion d'ici fin 2027, il faudrait encore quatre à cinq ans avant de voir ces technologies largement déployées dans différents secteurs", a ajouté Wang Xiaogang, également cofondateur de SenseTime, spécialiste chinois de la reconnaissance faciale par IA. Si les grands modèles de langage comme ChatGPT ou DeepSeek se sont imposés dans le monde entier, les modèles d'IA permettant aux robots d'évoluer de manière autonome dans des environnements inconnus restent encore loin d'être aboutis. Les investisseurs accordent désormais davantage d'importance aux applications concrètes qu'aux démonstrations de danse ou de performances sportives. Cette semaine, Wang Xingxing, fondateur du constructeur chinois Unitree, a estimé que les "cerveaux" des robots pourraient connaître une avancée majeure d'ici deux à trois ans au plus tôt. Comme d'autres dirigeants du secteur, il a souligné que l'accès à des données d'entraînement de qualité issues du monde réel demeurait l'un des principaux obstacles. Fondée en juillet 2025 et soutenue notamment par Ant Group et SenseTime, ACE Robotics a levé plus de 100 millions de dollars (86 millions d'euros) au cours du premier semestre de cette année. Selon Wang Xiaogang, l'entreprise ambitionne de s'introduire en Bourse "dès que cela sera possible", alors que la réglementation chinoise impose généralement au moins trois années d'activité avant une cotation. Le modèle open source Kairos-4B d'ACE Robotics figure en tête de plusieurs classements publics, devant notamment Cosmos 3 de Nvidia et Lingbot d'Ant Group. Ce modèle du monde intègre la perception, la compréhension multimodale, la simulation physique et la planification des actions. Il est également capable de générer des séquences vidéo et de prédire des actions sur plusieurs minutes. LA COLLECTE DE DONNÉES S'ACCÉLÈRE De nombreuses entreprises du secteur, dont [USN:L6N44G0KD TEXT:"Unitree"] et la start-up X Square, développent leurs propres modèles d’IA incarnée, mais Wang Xiaogang indique que "ces dernières années, l’ensemble du secteur n'a accumulé qu'environ 100.000 heures de données, ce qui est très insuffisant". Il affirme qu'ACE accélère la collecte de données en équipant de capteurs légers des opérateurs travaillant sur de véritables lignes de production. "L'efficacité de collecte est extrêmement élevée. Nous prévoyons d'accumuler des dizaines de millions d'heures de données dans les deux prochaines années", a-t-il ajouté. De nombreuses entreprises entraînent leurs robots par téléopération physique : des travailleurs équipés d'exosquelettes et de contrôleurs répètent les mêmes mouvements des centaines de fois afin de générer des données d'apprentissage. ACE déploie ses modèles dans des magasins automatisés, des hôtels et des entrepôts de livraison rapide, avec des robots humanoïdes fabriqués par Unitree, AgiBot et Fourier. "Nous prévoyons un déploiement dans au moins 1.000 magasins au cours de l'année à venir, puis dans 10.000 magasins d'ici deux ans", a déclaré Wang Xiaogang. Pour entraîner ses modèles, l'entreprise utilise des puces d'IA de Nvidia mais aussi de fabricants chinois comme Rhino Tech et Digua Robotics. "Cela nous permet de diversifier notre chaîne d'approvisionnement, car nous aurons besoin à l'avenir de solutions matérielles intelligentes complètes à des coûts bien plus faibles", a-t-il ajouté.

item.title: Guggenheim fund hits 17-year low after short-seller claims
item.description: Shares of close-ended Guggenheim Strategic Opportunities Fund hit their lowest level in over 17 years on Friday, a day after dropping sharply following allegations from a short-seller.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares of close-ended Guggenheim Strategic Opportunities Fund hit their lowest level in over 17 years on Friday, a day after dropping sharply following allegations from a short-seller. Its shares (GOF.N) were last down 3.7% at $9.07, their lowest since March 2009, a day after plunging over 6% on record volume. Here are some details: In a Substack post on Thursday, The Bear Cave, a newsletter focused on short-selling owned by Hunterbrook Media, alleged the fund has been paying distributions to shareholders by selling new shares at a premium to its net asset value, and questioned how the payments could continue in the future. The fund — whose biggest holdings include mortgage-backed securities and other fixed income assets — was trading at an 8.7% discount to NAV at Thursday's close, according to Guggenheim's website. The NAV last stood at $10.32. Guggenheim Partners and Hunterbrook did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Hunterbrook Media's investment affiliate, Hunterbrook Capital, does not have any positions related to the fund, according to the newsletter. Earlier this week, media reports [USN:L4N44E0LU TEXT:"said"] that U.S. federal prosecutors and the SEC are probing Guggenheim Partners CEO Mark Walter's business empire to determine whether Walter or his businesses committed fraud by concealing financial connections while borrowing billions of dollars from insurers he controls. TWG Global, Walter's holding company, said on Tuesday it had agreed to [USN:L4N44F0SP TEXT:"swap"] up to $6.5 billion of Walter's insurance company Delaware Life's related-party investments for an equivalent amount of assets classified as independent.

item.title: Tennis-Blessé, le N°1 mondial Jannik Sinner forfait pour l'US Open
item.description: Le numéro un mondial Jannik Sinner a déclaré forfait pour l'US Open (23 août-13 septembre) à cause d'une douleur persistante au genou droit, a indiqué vendredi le joueur italien de 24 ans.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le numéro un mondial Jannik Sinner a déclaré forfait pour l'US Open (23 août-13 septembre) à cause d'une douleur persistante au genou droit, a indiqué vendredi le joueur italien de 24 ans. Vainqueur de son cinquième titre du Grand Chelem sur la pelouse de Wimbledon le mois dernier, Jannik Sinner s'est depuis blessé au genou et a dû se retirer du Master 1000 de Cincinnati et de l'Open du Canada, deux tournois importants dans la préparation de l'US Open. "Même si j'ai travaillé dur avec mon équipe et le staff médical, nous avons désormais pris la décision difficile que je ne pourrai pas participer à l'US Open cette année", a-t-il déclaré sur X. "Nous avons été de retour sur le court à Monte-Carlo ces deux derniers jours et avons réalisé que j'avais encore besoin de temps pour récupérer de mon problème à mon genou droit." Le forfait du numéro un mondial intervient alors que son plus grand rival, Carlos Alcaraz, a confirmé sa présence à Flushing Meadows, après quatre mois d'absence. Tenant du titre, l'Espagnol est désormais le grand favori à sa propre succession, malgré l'incertitude liée à son absence prolongée.

item.title: Orbital data center startup Starcloud valued at $2.3 billion in latest funding
item.description: Starcloud, a startup building data centers in space, said on Friday it had raised $250 million at a $2.3 billion valuation, as it looks to expand AI infrastructure through orbital data centers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Starcloud, a startup building data centers in space, said on Friday it had raised $250 million at a $2.3 billion valuation, as it looks to expand AI infrastructure through orbital data centers. SpaceX's (SPCX.O) [USN:L6N42J1AD TEXT:"blockbuster IPO"] has rekindled investor interest in the space industry, including in emerging areas such as orbital data centers. Here are some details: Manhattan West led the round that included new investors Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Cisco Investments (CSCO.O) , alongside existing backers Benchmark, EQT and Soma, among others. The startup was previously valued at [USN:L6N40E0WQ TEXT:"$1.1 billion in March"], when it raised $170 million. The funding brings Starcloud's total capital raised to $450 million since its founding in 2024. The startup said it was working with Nvidia on the Nvidia Space-1 Vera Rubin Module, designed to withstand radiation and extreme conditions in orbit. The capital raised will be used to fund manufacturing capacity expansion, engineering collaboration with Nvidia and procurement for newer products. Starcloud is targeting a constellation of 88,000 satellites and 20 gigawatts of orbital compute capacity, and building a 100,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Woodinville, Washington, for its next-generation Starcloud-3 spacecraft. Manhattan West's Lauren Selig has joined Starcloud's board as an observer.

item.title: Ken Griffin's Citadel sheds over $4 billion of Situational Awareness' bets
item.description: Billionaire investor Ken Griffin's Citadel has shed more than 80%, or $4 billion of bets, from the original portfolio of Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness that it recently purchased, according to a letter to investors seen by Reuters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Anirban Sen, Arasu Basil
item.content:encoded: Billionaire investor Ken Griffin's Citadel has shed more than 80%, or $4 billion of bets, from the original portfolio of Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness that it recently purchased, according to a letter to investors seen by Reuters on Friday. Situational, an AI-focused hedge fund run by former OpenAI researcher Aschenbrenner, sold the [USN:L6N43W181 TEXT:"bulk of its stock bets to Citadel"] last month after heavy losses in its tech holdings forced it to unwind most of its public equities portfolio. Citadel has since completed nearly 100 block trades as it shed positions in the portfolio, which Griffin said included the largest intraday block trades of the year in 10 different names. The firm, which has about $77 billion of assets under management, declined to comment. "Our ability to distribute this risk was central to our investment thesis. These moments highlight our ability to quickly evaluate complex risks, deploy capital with speed and conviction, and execute with precision," Griffin said in the letter. Citadel is one of the world's most profitable and largest hedge funds, and has built a reputation for [USN:L6N43X1DP TEXT:"seizing opportunities during periods of market dislocation"]. After a selloff in AI stocks, the Situational Awareness portfolio lost 67% of its value in July, and was forced to unwind most of its $16 billion public equities book. Griffin and his top lieutenants had pulled an all-nighter to analyze the trading book positions of Situational and how liquid the bets were, Reuters reported last month. "A transaction of this magnitude could not have been completed without the extraordinary cooperation of the trading and prime brokerage teams at the banks serving both firms," Griffin said. Citadel Wellington, the firm's flagship multi-strategy fund, [USN:L1N4420KK TEXT:"gained 5.94% in July"], leaving it up 12% for the year.

item.title: Französische Behörden rufen Zehntausende unsichere Kondome zurück
item.description: Französische Behörden haben vor dem Gebrauch Zehntausender potenziell unsicherer Kondome gewarnt und rund 260.000 in Apotheken und Geschäften verkaufte Präservative zurückgerufen. Labortests hätten bei zwei Produkten ergeben, dass sie platzen oder Löcher aufweisen könnten, teilten die Anti-Betrugs-Behörde DGCCRF und die Gesundheitsbehörde DGS am Freitag mit. Verbrauchern, die diese Kondome verwendet haben, wurde geraten, sich auf sexuell übertragbare Krankheiten testen zu lassen und bei Ausbleiben der Menstruation einen Schwangerschaftstest zu machen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Französische Behörden haben vor dem Gebrauch Zehntausender potenziell unsicherer Kondome gewarnt und rund 260.000 in Apotheken und Geschäften verkaufte Präservative zurückgerufen. Labortests hätten bei zwei Produkten ergeben, dass sie platzen oder Löcher aufweisen könnten, teilten die Anti-Betrugs-Behörde DGCCRF und die Gesundheitsbehörde DGS am Freitag mit. Verbrauchern, die diese Kondome verwendet haben, wurde geraten, sich auf sexuell übertragbare Krankheiten testen zu lassen und bei Ausbleiben der Menstruation einen Schwangerschaftstest zu machen. Zudem seien auf Online-Marktplätzen 30 Kondomvarianten entdeckt worden, denen das EU-Konformitätssiegel oder eine französische Beschriftung fehle, hieß es weiter. Davon seien rund 1000 Schachteln mit mehr als 40.000 Kondomen verkauft worden. Die Plattformen hätten zugesagt, die Angebote zu entfernen. Auf der Warnliste stehen unter anderem zwei Produkte des japanischen Herstellers Okamoto Industries (5122.T) sowie die Marken My Lubie und Friday Bae von Passage du Desir. Die betroffenen Unternehmen äußerten sich auf Anfrage zunächst nicht dazu.

item.title: Malaysia's JDT stay unbeaten for world record 109th league match
item.description: Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) set a world record of 109 consecutive league matches unbeaten after opening the Malaysian Super League season with a 3-0 victory over Kuching City in the Charity Shield on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT) set a world record of 109 consecutive league matches unbeaten after opening the Malaysian Super League season with a 3-0 victory over Kuching City in the Charity Shield on Friday. Marcos Guilherme scored in the 11th minute, while Oscar Arribas and Shahab Zahedi each found the net in the second half as JDT picked a comfortable win at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. The win saw JDT surpass the 108-match streak that Ivory Coast's ASEC Mimosas compiled between 1989 and 1994, which the Malaysian club had matched with a 14-1 victory over Kelantan The Real Warriors in their final match of last season in May. The Southern Tigers have not lost a league match since April 2021 and have gone unbeaten through the last four Malaysian Super League campaigns. "It's a proud moment of my career being part of this amazing five-year run that has seen us go 109 matches unbeaten in the league, thus setting a new world record," JDT's Spanish coach Xisco Munoz said. "Our aim now is to keep this streak going and make the numbers even greater. Club CEO and former Liverpool Champions League winner Luis Garcia added: "I've played for and seen many dominant teams during my career in Europe, so I know how tough staying unbeaten can be no matter how strong you are. "Everyone just wants to beat you and treats every match against you like a final, same as how it is for JDT." JDT, chasing a 13th straight league title, have come close to completing a perfect season in recent years, dropping points in only one league game in each of the last three campaigns. The club drew 3-3 with Premier League side Chelsea in a pre-season friendly earlier this month. Having taken the first step in their latest title defence, JDT will look to extend their record streak when they face Kelantan Red Warrior FC on Wednesday.

item.title: Las potencias de Oriente Medio condenan los planes israelíes de asentamientos en Cisjordania
item.description: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Turquía, Egipto, Indonesia, Jordania, Pakistán, Qatar, Arabia Saudita y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos condenaron las políticas de asentamientos de Israel en los territorios palestinos y dijeron que rechazaban categóricamente el proyecto inmobiliario residencial denominado «E1» en la Cisjordania ocupada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Turquía, Egipto, Indonesia, Jordania, Pakistán, Qatar, Arabia Saudita y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos condenaron las políticas de asentamientos de Israel en los territorios palestinos y dijeron que rechazaban categóricamente el proyecto inmobiliario residencial denominado «E1» en la Cisjordania ocupada. "Los ministros exigen que se tomen medidas inmediatas para detener el plan de asentamientos 'E1', revocar todas las medidas adoptadas en relación con él y poner fin a todas las actividades de asentamiento y demás medidas destinadas a alterar el carácter geográfico y demográfico del territorio palestino ocupado", dijeron en un comunicado conjunto. Los diplomáticos añadieron que el plan constituía una "escalada peligrosa" que impulsaba aún más la expansión de los asentamientos y la anexión de territorios palestinos.

item.title: Russell takes sprint pole at Dutch Grand Prix ahead of Norris
item.description: George Russell beat McLaren's Lando Norris to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race on Friday in a strong statement of intent by the Mercedes driver as he seeks to turn around a tough first half of the Formula One season.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: George Russell beat McLaren's Lando Norris to pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race on Friday in a strong statement of intent by the Mercedes driver as he seeks to turn around a tough first half of the Formula One season. Returning from the August break with an engagement ring and a fresh spring in his step, Russell produced a best lap of one minute 11.567 seconds to beat the reigning champion by 0.041 of a second and secure his third pole from five sprints so far this season. "It's great to be back here after the break. It's a circuit I love. It needs a lot of commitment," said Russell, third overall in the standings and 59 points behind teammate Kimi Antonelli. "It was a tough end to the first half of the year and I'm really happy to come back. "The lap felt really good. It all came together really nicely. It's always difficult these sprint qualifyings with just one shot on the soft tyre." LECLERC QUALIFIED THIRD FOR FERRARI Ferrari's Charles Leclerc will line up third on the grid for Saturday's race at the gusty seaside Zandvoort circuit with McLaren's Oscar Piastri fourth and Antonelli qualifying fifth in a damaged Mercedes after an early excursion into the gravel. Home hero and four-time world champion Max Verstappen was sixth fastest for Red Bull and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, Antonelli's closest rival in the standings and 50 points behind, qualified seventh with Alpine's Pierre Gasly eighth. The sprint winner takes eight points with the top eight scoring. The big points come from Sunday's main race, after Saturday's grand prix qualifying. "George is coming back. I think he feels so much pressure is off his shoulders after she (fiancee Carmen Montero Mundt) accepted his marriage proposal," joked Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff. Norris, winner of the last grand prix in Hungary before the break, said he could easily have been first or fifth considering the closeness of the field. "Maybe I could have just pushed it a little bit more, but otherwise the car has been performing well and looks like it’s continued its strong performance from Budapest," said the Briton. "It’s not an easy track to overtake (on) and the inside of the grid is a lot worse than the left side of the grid, so let’s see.” Antonelli went into the gravel during the first phase when he was only eighth fastest and Wolff revealed there had been significant floor damage that the team had patched up. "I had a couple of holes in the floor," said the Italian, who turns 20 next week. “When I came in, they initially said it was a loss of 25 points (of downforce). They tried to repair as much as possible, but definitely the damage was still there. I was struggling a lot in the low-speed corners." Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto qualified ninth with rookie Arvid Lindblad 10th for Racing Bulls. Liam Lawson, promoted from Racing Bulls to stand in for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull, qualified 11th while his Racing Bulls replacement Yuki Tsunoda was 12th. There was disappointment for Fernando Alonso at Aston Martin, whose hopes for a performance boost from the upgraded Honda engine were undermined by a rear wing problem on the Spaniard's car that left the double world champion at the back of the grid.

item.title: Zone euro-Légère amélioration surprise de la confiance des consommateurs en août
item.description: La confiance des consommateurs de la zone euro s'est légèrement améliorée depuis le début du mois d'août, montrent vendredi les résultats préliminaires de l'enquête mensuelle de la Commission européenne.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La confiance des consommateurs de la zone euro s'est légèrement améliorée depuis le début du mois d'août, montrent vendredi les résultats préliminaires de l'enquête mensuelle de la Commission européenne. L'indice est ressorti à -15,5 ce mois-ci, contre -15,9 en juillet, alors que les économistes interrogés par Reuters tablaient sur une dégradation à -16,3.

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre en hausse, la prudence reste de mise
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en hausse vendredi, rebondissant face à ses pertes de la veille, même si les turbulences sur le marché obligataire et les tensions géopolitiques freinent l'appétit pour le risque.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en hausse vendredi, rebondissant face à ses pertes de la veille, même si les turbulences sur le marché obligataire et les tensions géopolitiques freinent l'appétit pour le risque. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 274,50 points, soit 0,52%, à 53.033,71 points et le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large progresse 0,45% à 7.675,80 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) avance de 0,49% à 26.194,69 points. La flambée des rendements des bons du Trésor américain à long terme a suscité de l'inquiétude sur les marchés cette semaine, poussant le taux de l'obligation à 30 ans à atteindre, en début de semaine, son plus haut niveau depuis 2007. Bien que le Trésor soit intervenu pour annoncer qu'il doublerait les rachats de ces titres, les rendements restent proches de leurs plus hauts récents, ce qui, conjugué à l'impasse diplomatique au Moyen-Orient, incite les investisseurs à la prudence. Aux valeurs, les actions liées au [USN:L8N44I0DV TEXT:"secteur des crypto-actifs"] grimpent pour la deuxième séance consécutive, soutenues par la hausse du bitcoin après la décision du Trésor de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N44I0DV]

item.title: Gemeinde in Schweden: Mehrere Verletzte bei Schwertangriff
item.description: Bei einem Angriff mit einem Schwert sind in Schweden nach Angaben von Behörden mehrere Menschen verletzt worden. Zu der Tat sei es am Freitag an einer Oberschule in Fagersta in Zentralschweden gekommen, teilte die Gemeinde mit. Die Polizei nahm nach eigenen Angaben eine Person fest. Auf Anfrage der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters erklärte die Polizei, mittlerweile bestehe für die Bevölkerung keine Gefahr mehr. Nach dem Angriff wurden mehrere weitere Schulen und öffentliche Gebäude in Fagersta vorübergehend abgeriegelt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bei einem Angriff mit einem Schwert sind in Schweden nach Angaben von Behörden mehrere Menschen verletzt worden. Zu der Tat sei es am Freitag an einer Oberschule in Fagersta in Zentralschweden gekommen, teilte die Gemeinde mit. Die Polizei nahm nach eigenen Angaben eine Person fest. Auf Anfrage der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters erklärte die Polizei, mittlerweile bestehe für die Bevölkerung keine Gefahr mehr. Nach dem Angriff wurden mehrere weitere Schulen und öffentliche Gebäude in Fagersta vorübergehend abgeriegelt. Die Zeitung "Expressen" berichtete unter Berufung auf Insider, die Polizei habe auf den Verdächtigen geschossen. Reuters konnte diesen Bericht zunächst nicht bestätigen. Justizminister Gunnar Strömmer erklärte auf Anfrage, die Regierung stehe nach dem Angriff in engem Kontakt mit der Polizei. Der Vorfall ereignete sich ein Jahr nach einem Amoklauf an einer Schule in Örebro. Damals hatte ein Schütze zehn Menschen getötet und sich anschließend selbst das Leben genommen.

item.title: Iran-linked oil tanker falls victim to Somali piracy surge
item.description: An oil tanker under U.S. sanctions for allegedly transporting Iranian petroleum products has become the latest victim of resurgent Somali piracy when it was boarded off the coast of Yemen and diverted toward Somalia.
item.dc:creator: Aaron Ross
item.content:encoded: An oil tanker under U.S. sanctions for allegedly transporting Iranian petroleum products has become the latest victim of [USN:L1N41A07O TEXT:"resurgent Somali piracy"] when it was boarded off the coast of Yemen and diverted toward Somalia. The Eritrea-flagged Sibu 1 [USN:nL1N44H0CX TEXT:"was seized"] on Thursday by six armed individuals, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO). The tanker was sanctioned last December by the U.S. Treasury for allegedly being part of a shadow fleet that helps Iranian petroleum products evade U.S. sanctions. The Sibu 1 was at least the 13th vessel attacked this year off the coast of Somalia or in the Gulf of Aden that links Somalia and Yemen, according to data from the International Maritime Bureau and reports by UKMTO. There were only five such attacks in all of 2025, according to the IMB data. Hundreds of attacks by Somali pirates from 2008 to 2014 created a security crisis in the western Indian Ocean that cost the global economy billions of dollars, including hundreds of millions of dollars in ransoms. A coordinated international security response largely ended those attacks and a spate of hijackings in 2023 and 2024 also died down following a robust naval response. But experts say the failure to address the root causes of piracy linked to poor economic and security conditions in Somalia mean it can always re-emerge. "The piracy was always suppressed. It was never really fully eradicated," said Timothy Walker, a senior researcher at the Institute for Security Studies in Pretoria. Experts have pointed to impacts of the Iran war on the piracy surge, including elevated oil prices that make tankers more attractive targets and the diversion of naval assets previously focused on piracy to the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea to deal with threats from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen. Some have cited evidence of collaboration between the Houthis and Somali pirates after several vessels were seized near the Yemeni coast. Jay Bahadur, a researcher and co-director of the Scopus Insights consultancy, said the seizure of an Iran-linked vessel like Sibu 1 made him very sceptical of Houthi links to the recent hijackings but added it was clear Somali pirates were receiving support from Yemeni nationals, including arms trafficking networks. "You're having these traditional, longstanding relationships built around arms trafficking and human smuggling built up between Yemeni criminal actors and Somali criminal actors," he said.

item.title: MARCHÉS-Le bitcoin s'envole après les annonces du Trésor US sur l'obligataire
item.description: Le bitcoin poursuit vendredi sa remontée, frôlant les 78.000 dollars, après la décision du Trésor de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le bitcoin poursuit vendredi sa remontée, frôlant les 78.000 dollars, après la décision du Trésor de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies La plus importante cryptomonnaie au monde, avance de 5,6% à 76.681 dollars vers 13h30 GMT après avoir frôlé les 80.000 dollars plus tôt dans la journée, son plus haut niveau depuis la mi-mai. Il y a seulement trois séances, le bitcoin s'échangeait à environ 64.000 dollars. Le Trésor américain a annoncé mercredi son intention de doubler les rachats de dette à long terme, afin de répondre aux craintes inflationnistes liées à la guerre au Moyen-Orient, mais aussi à l'envolée des coûts de financement dans un contexte d'augmentation des dépenses publiques. "Avec une dette publique américaine désormais supérieure à 40.000 milliards de dollars, toute politique visant à contenir les rendements obligataires ravive les craintes de dépréciation monétaire à long terme", écrit Antoine Fraysse-Soulier, responsable de l'analyse des marchés pour etoro. "L'or en profite, mais le Bitcoin également, avec son offre plafonnée à 21 millions d'unités, ajoute-t-il. En plus, le locataire de la Maison blanche a appelé cette semaine le Congrès à adopter une "version équitable du Clarity Act", un projet de loi qui, selon les entreprises du secteur des cryptomonnaies, leur apporterait une base juridique solide, mais qui est actuellement bloqué au Sénat alors qu'il ne reste que peu de temps avant la fin de la session parlementaire. Les actions liées au secteur grimpent en Bourse pour la deuxième séance consécutive.

item.title: Artificial intelligence could push up inflation - SNB's Tschudin says
item.description: Artificial intelligence can push inflation higher in the short term although the overall effect of the technology remains unclear, Swiss National Bank governing board member Petra Tschudin said in an interview published on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Artificial intelligence can push inflation higher in the short term although the overall effect of the technology remains unclear, Swiss National Bank governing board member Petra Tschudin said in an interview published on Friday. The central bank was looking closely at the impact of AI on prices, saying it could have an effect in both directions, Tschudin told newspaper Finanz und Wirtschaft. "Investment flows are being partly redirected, which can mean adjustments and difficulties for the rest of the economy," Tschudin said. "Shortages can occur, for example with chips, causing prices to rise. In the short or medium term, therefore, upward inflationary pressure can also arise." In the longer term artificial intelligence could also lower prices by increasing productivity and making goods cheaper, she said. But because inflation was calculated on an annual basis, to have a deflationary effect, this price decline would have to repeat itself regularly, she said. "Is that realistic? Productivity gains as such are not a new phenomenon. They do not, by themselves, lead an economy into structural deflation," Tschudin said. On Thursday, the International Monetary Fund's new chief economist Silvana Tenreyro [USN:L8N44H0UE TEXT:"also warned"] in research published by Bank of England staff that even if artificial intelligence boosts productivity, it may not lower inflation. In its latest forecast the SNB does not see inflation above or below its target range for annual price rises of 0% to 2% in the period up to the first quarter of 2029. Still, Tschudin said this should not be seen as a forecast the central bank will not change its policy interest rate, which currently stands at 0%. Instead the forecast was based on how the central bank saw inflation if interest rates remained unchanged. "If there is new relevant information about inflation, we adjust monetary policy," Tschudin said. "The conditional inflation forecast should not be understood to mean that interest rates will remain at their current level for three years. We do not publish interest rate forecasts."

item.title: Official creditors back Ethiopia bond restructuring, flag risks in warrant
item.description: Ethiopia's official creditors have approved a preliminary agreement between the government and private investors to restructure its $1 billion Eurobond, the finance ministry said on Friday, moving the country closer to emerging from default.
item.dc:creator: Nilutpal Timsina, Vincent Nzilani, Duncan Miriri
item.content:encoded: Ethiopia's official creditors have approved a preliminary agreement between the government and private investors to restructure its $1 billion Eurobond, the finance ministry said on Friday, moving the country closer to emerging from default. The East African nation struck an [USN:L8N43108T TEXT:"agreement in "]principle (AIP) with its bondholders in June to restructure the bond that was due in 2024 following several failed attempts, including a January proposal that bilateral creditors said did not comply with debt relief terms already agreed with Ethiopia. Ethiopia's Official Creditor Committee (OCC), which is co-chaired by France and China, has been studying the deal, the finance ministry said in a statement that also contained the letter from the group. "The OCC considers that, at this stage, the AIP is compliant with the principle of comparability of treatment and the Memorandum of Understanding agreed with Ethiopia," the committee said in its letter to the Ethiopian finance ministry. The move means the government will now go ahead with the implementation of the draft deal agreed with bondholders, the ministry said. Bilateral creditors and the government finalised a deal last year to restructure their portion of the external debt. OCC CAUTIOUS ABOUT NEW INSTRUMENT The committee, however, cautioned that the inclusion in the draft deal with bondholders of a "New Money Warrant" could ultimately result in bondholders receiving more favourable treatment than official creditors. This could force bilateral creditors to adjust their terms to match those of bondholders. The warrant gives bondholders the option to buy into a future Ethiopian bond of up to $1 billion at a market-linked interest rate, the terms of the June deal showed, and the government has an option to settle the warrant in cash instead, capped at $90 million. "Should the New Money Warrant be shown to grant excessive benefits to bondholders, such as through repurchase or redemption of the instrument, the OCC would consider the implications for the comparability of treatment," the OCC said. Market participants said the warrant was the key to unlocking the deadlock between the government and bondholders — a position that official creditors acknowledged. But the committee warned this would not set a precedent. "The OCC... will closely monitor its implementation before considering another potential replication of such an instrument in the future," it said. The Paris Club, which usually handles communications from official creditors for restructuring under the G20 Common Framework, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. COMMON FRAMEWORK TEST Ethiopia opted to rework its debt in 2021 under the G20's Common Framework — the sole remaining country still undergoing this process. The country defaulted on its sole Eurobond in 2023, following in the footsteps of Ghana and Zambia. Investors and campaigners pushing for fairer debt terms for developing nations see the resolution of its default as a test of the Common Framework, launched during the COVID-19 pandemic to streamline debt workouts. Its implementation has been marked by divisions between Western lenders, China and private investors that have slowed and complicated restructurings. The Ad Hoc Bondholder Committee, which represents 45% of investors in Ethiopia's bond, said in June that the restructuring had exposed deep flaws in the Common Framework. The committee did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Bondholders must still approve the deal before it can take effect.

item.title: ONS eleva previsão para crescimento da carga de energia no Brasil em agosto
item.description: O Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) aumentou sua estimativa para a carga de energia no Brasil em agosto, esperando agora um crescimento de 6,3% no comparativo anual, para 82.791 megawatts médios, contra uma alta de 5,6% prevista na semana anterior.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) aumentou sua estimativa para a carga de energia no Brasil em agosto, esperando agora um crescimento de 6,3% no comparativo anual, para 82.791 megawatts médios, contra uma alta de 5,6% prevista na semana anterior. Com o aumento do consumo de energia, o ONS reduziu sua previsão para o nível dos principais reservatórios de hidrelétricas do país, localizados no subsistema Sudeste/Centro-Oeste. A expectativa é de que cheguem a 58,7% da capacidade ao final de agosto, contra 59,4% esperados há uma semana. Para as chuvas que deverão chegar às hidrelétricas do país no mês, o órgão manteve a expectativa para o Sudeste/Centro-Oeste (93% da média histórica), enquanto reduziu para o Sul (180%, ante 184% na previsão anterior), Nordeste (62%, ante 63%) e Norte (61%, ante 63%).

item.title: JPMorgan hiring Bank of America's David Fishman as head of technology M&A, memo says
item.description: JPMorgan Chase is hiring veteran dealmaker David Fishman from Bank of America as part of a newly formed investment banking group to focus on key clients in the technology sector, according to a memo seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) is hiring veteran dealmaker David Fishman from Bank of America (BAC.N) as part of a newly formed investment banking group to focus on key clients in the technology sector, according to a memo seen by Reuters. Fishman will join JPMorgan later this year as head of North America technology mergers and acquisitions, according to the memo from co-heads of technology investment banking Chris Grose and Greg Mendelson, as well as Global Head of M&A Charlie Bouckaert. JPMorgan is elevating Vineet Seth, the head of technology M&A in North America, to vice chair of investment banking, and both Fishman and Seth will also serve on the bank's Technology M&A Leadership and Advisory Council. The grouping is being formed to support the bank's most important technology clients, the memo added, without elaborating. A JPMorgan spokesperson confirmed the memo's contents. Bank of America declined to comment. Fishman was at Bank of America for almost 16 years, according to his LinkedIn profile. He most recently served as co-head of technology, media and telecommunications (TMT) investment banking, but resigned from the bank earlier this week, according to sources familiar with the matter. The move is the latest in a series of recent departures of senior investment bankers from Bank of America. Reuters and others reported this month that Mike Joo, co-head of investment banking, and Amy Lissauer, head of activism and raid defense, would leave Bank of America. Barclays said this week [USN:L6N44E0QX TEXT:"it had hired"] Joo and he would start as co-chief executive of its investment bank in early 2027. Lissauer, considered among the top bankers for defending companies against shareholder agitation, is [USN:L1N44218I TEXT:"joining JPMorgan"] later this year. Bank of America's technology practice has also had several exits. Ed Liu was named this month as global head of TMT investment banking at Deutsche Bank (DBKGn.DE) . He will [USN:L1N44315E TEXT:"join the German bank"] in November. Reuters also reported on August 4 that Citigroup (C.N) hired [USN:L6N4400ZS TEXT:"Rohan Sen"] from Bank of America to lead its coverage of the technology services sector. Bank of America has hired over 40 managing directors this year, including Jason Rowe from Goldman Sachs, who became co-head of technology investment banking, and [USN:L6N3ZX1HF TEXT:"Gary Kirkham"], who was a senior partner and head of technology at boutique bank Centerview Partners before rejoining Bank of America.

item.title: NFL transactions roundup: Falcons add DT depth
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons signed defensive tackle Eric Johnson II on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Atlanta Falcons signed defensive tackle Eric Johnson II on Friday. A fifth-round pick by Indianapolis in 2022, Johnson has appeared in 51 games (no starts) and recorded 41 tackles, one sack and one fumble recovery with the Colts (2022-23, 2025) and New England Patriots (2024). Johnson, 28, spent the offseason and training camp with the Minnesota Vikings before being released on Wednesday. --The Colts signed free agent tight end JJ Galbreath and waived cornerback Jai'Onte' McMillan. Galbreath spent 2025 on the Pittsburgh Steelers' practice squad after going undrafted out of South Dakota, where he caught 93 passes for 1,355 yards and 12 touchdowns in 45 games (30 starts) from 2020-24. McMillan signed with the Colts on June 1 as an undrafted free agent after playing collegiately at TCU (2020-23) and Minnesota (2024-25). --Field Level Media

item.title: Arsenal bolster defence with Konsa signing from Villa
item.description: Arsenal have signed England international Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa on a long-term contract, the Premier League champions said on Friday as they boosted their defensive options.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Arsenal have signed England international Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa on a long-term contract, the Premier League champions said on Friday as they boosted their defensive options. The 28-year-old joins the North London club in a deal worth a reported 55 million pounds ($74.94 million) including add-ons, according to British media. “I’m super excited. It's a privilege to be here and can’t wait to get started,” Konsa said in a statement. “I want to keep winning, I’m hungry to win and that’s what I’m here for. It's a proud moment for me and my family to play for one of the best teams in the world.” Konsa arrives at the Emirates Stadium after six seasons at Villa, where he made 286 appearances following his move from Brentford in 2019. A key figure in Villa's Europa League-winning campaign last season, he played 48 games in all competitions. Konsa also featured for England at the 2026 World Cup, starting seven matches and scoring in the third-place playoff against France which England won 6-4. He has 28 caps. The versatile defender is expected to play an important role for Arsenal this season as they deal with injuries to William Saliba and Jurrien Timber. Saliba faces an extended spell out with a back injury, while Timber has struggled with a groin problem since March and was not fit enough to represent the Netherlands at the World Cup. Arsenal begin their Premier League title defence at home to Coventry City later on Friday. ($1 = 0.7339 pounds)

item.title: Boeing white-collar union contract vote results expected today
item.description: Voting on Boeing's contract offer to its largest white-collar union ends on Friday, with results expected by mid-afternoon in Seattle.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Voting on Boeing's (BA.N) contract offer to its largest white-collar union ends on Friday, with results expected by mid-afternoon in Seattle. Hoping to avoid a strike by thousands of engineers and technical workers, Boeing offered terms that were better than expected, several members of the Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA) told Reuters. However, neither of the bargaining unit councils for SPEEA's engineers and technicians units backed the offer. The technicians unit council recommended that members reject the offer, while the engineers unit council did not meet the 60% threshold needed to give members a recommendation to accept or reject. The tentative agreement reached with Boeing in late July was endorsed by SPEEA's negotiating team. The engineers and technicians units negotiate collectively with Boeing, but they vote separately. The current contract expires in October. Speaking to Wall Street analysts in July, Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg said the company "began these discussions early, because we wanted to work towards an agreement that supports our employees and their families, creates greater clarity for our business and helps us stay focused on the progress we're making." A work stoppage by SPEEA members would further delay Boeing's certification campaigns for its 737 Max 10 and 777-9, both of which are several years behind schedule. The proposed four-year contract includes wage increases tied to inflation (capped at 3%) and an individual's performance, as well as other metrics determined by the company, but not specified in the contract. Several SPEEA members who have already voted to reject the offer told Reuters that capping inflation-based raises at 3% nearly guarantees that their salaries will fall behind inflation. In 2024, Boeing commercial airplane production in the Seattle area ground to a halt when the roughly 33,000 members of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers went on strike for seven weeks.

item.title: Report: Private equity firm Arctos buying 10% of Falcons
item.description: Arctos Partners is adding a fourth NFL franchise to its portfolio by purchasing a 10% stake in the Atlanta Falcons, Front Office Sports and CNBC reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Arctos Partners is adding a fourth NFL franchise to its portfolio by purchasing a 10% stake in the Atlanta Falcons, Front Office Sports and CNBC reported. The private equity firm already owns stakes in the Buffalo Bills, Cleveland Browns and Los Angeles Chargers. The deal with Arctos includes a $10.6 billion valuation for the Falcons. Arctos will acquire the 10% stake in two stages, starting with a 7.5% stake, according to Sportico. A vote on the transaction is planned for October. According to NFL rules, a private equity firm can invest in no more than six teams and the maximum stake size is 10%. Falcons owner Arthur Blank owns about 73% of the team but it is unclear whether his shares are involved in the deal with Arctos, according to Front Office Sports. Arctos, which is owned by the sports management company KKR & Co. Inc., also holds a stake in several franchises in the NBA, NHL and MLB. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bok captain Du Toit warns concentration is key to seeing off All Blacks threat
item.description: South Africa must keep their wits about them and ensure concentration levels are consistent to counter New Zealand's attacking prowess when the foes meet in the first of their four-test series on Saturday, said home captain Pieter-Steph du Toit.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gleeson
item.content:encoded: South Africa must keep their wits about them and ensure concentration levels are consistent to counter New Zealand's attacking prowess when the foes meet in the first of their four-test series on Saturday, said home captain Pieter-Steph du Toit. They are set for a potentially titanic tussle as the All Blacks tour South Africa for the first time in 30 years in what is billed as ‘Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry’ with the Springboks' power game against New Zealand’s pace and running prowess. “We know New Zealand are going to bring it with intensity,” Du Toit said on Friday at a press conference. “We really believe the line outs and the scrum are going to be something where we're going to have to perform well. "They're going to try and test us, finding gaps if we switch off. We know they're quite fast and have very skilful players. They're definitely going to try and exploit this and come up with good plans as well. “So I would say we have to be alert at all times and don't get caught out.” Du Toit, World Rugby Player of the Year in 2019 and 2024, continues as Bok captain after Siya Kolisi missed the Nations Championship wins over England, Scotland and Wales last month through injury and was left out of Saturday’s first test at Ellis Park. The added responsibility will not weigh too heavily on his shoulders, Du Toit added. “We've got a very good system and with all our coaches and players around me it makes it much easier. “We've got so many senior players, people have played a lot for Springboks, a lot of test experience. "Being able to captain the team is a huge honour but it doesn't change anything for me. I'm still focused on my game and what I have to do Saturday is play well and the rest will take care of itself." A first four-test series in 30 years makes it a novelty for the players, Du Toit added, and one they were relishing. “I would say it's very different with New Zealand playing four back-to-back games in South Africa. “It’s a massive honour and privilege to be able to play against them and face the Haka. Now the older you get, the biggest dream is to keep doing it. “At the moment, I'm trying to do everything I can to keep that dream alive and to still be there and add value and contribute to the team. And hopefully I can do this on Saturday,” added the 34-year-old.

item.title: Russia designates independent Mediazona news outlet as 'foreign agent'
item.description: Russia's Justice Ministry on Friday declared the independent Mediazona news outlet a "foreign agent", a designation used to label foreign-funded organisations that it says are engaged in political activity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia's Justice Ministry on Friday declared the independent Mediazona news outlet a "foreign agent", a designation used to label foreign-funded organisations that it says are engaged in political activity. Mediazona "disseminated false information about Russia's law enforcement system" and a number of its staff have already been labelled as foreign agents, the ministry said. The term "foreign agent" carries negative Soviet-era connotations and subjects those designated to extra government scrutiny. Mediazona said via its channel on the Telegram messaging app that this was the second time that Russian authorities had declared it to be a "foreign agent". Separately, its editor Yegor Skovoroda — who like the outlet's other journalists now works outside Russia — described the ministry's statement as "incredibly crazy". The news outlet was first designated as a "foreign agent" in 2021, and the Justice Ministry removed it from the register of authorised media organisations in Russia. Russian state communications regulator Roskomnadzor blocked Mediazona's website within Russia in March 2022, shortly after Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Russia has also opened criminal cases against several Mediazona journalists who are currently working from abroad, including editor-in-chief Sergei Smirnov.

item.title: 中国、対外投資の管理措置を改正へ 投資家保護を強化
item.description: ［北京 ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　２１日　ロイター］ - 中国国家発展改革委員会（ＮＤＲＣ）は２１日、投資家の権利と資産の保護を強化し、海外でのリスクに対応するため、対外投資の管理措置を改正する方針を明らかにした。

ＮＤＲＣは改正案を公表しており、９月２０日まで一般からの意見を募集する。

改正後の規則は、企業や他の組織、個人による対外投資を対象とする。２０１８年に施行された現行規則は企業や非法人組織の投資に適用されていたが、その範囲を拡大する形となる。

ＮＤＲＣは、今回の改正は中央政府の方針に沿ったものだと説明。中国国務院（内閣に相当）が６月に対外投資に関する新たな規定を出したことにも言及した。

ＮＤＲＣの改正措置に基づき、中国は「重大な悪影響を及ぼす事案」に関する報告制度を改善する。これには、国や地域が「差別的」な措置を採用し、中国企業に技術やデータの提供、または株式や資産の処分を要求した事例が含まれる。

ＮＤＲＣは、改正された規則では、一部の国における政情不安などのリスクから投資家を守る保護措置も強化するとした。

item.title: Equipos comerciales de EEUU y Canadá se reunirán de nuevo ante inminencia de plazo para aranceles
item.description: Los principales negociadores comerciales de Canadá y Estados Unidos se reunirán por tercer día consecutivo este viernes en Washington para intentar cerrar un acuerdo comercial antes de que entren en vigor el sábado los nuevos aranceles con los que amenaza Washington.
item.dc:creator: Greg Savoy
item.content:encoded: Los principales negociadores comerciales de Canadá y Estados Unidos se reunirán por tercer día consecutivo este viernes en Washington para intentar cerrar un acuerdo comercial antes de que entren en vigor el sábado los nuevos aranceles con los que amenaza Washington. Un acuerdo podría suponer un respiro en lo que han sido 18 meses de relaciones tensas, que comenzaron cuando el presidente Donald Trump impuso aranceles a importaciones clave procedentes de Canadá, lo que llevó a Ottawa a tomar represalias con un conjunto de contramedidas. Trump afirma que impondrá un nuevo gravamen del 50% sobre productos canadienses por valor de unos 20.000 millones de dólares a las 0401 GMT del sábado si no se alcanza un acuerdo. El ministro canadiense responsable del comercio con Estados Unidos, Dominic LeBlanc, tiene previsto reunirse con el representante comercial estadounidense, Jamieson Greer, a las 11:30 hora local (1530 GMT), informó la oficina de LeBlanc en un comunicado. LeBlanc se reunió con Greer durante más de tres horas el jueves y afirmó que ambas partes están "muy cerca" de alcanzar un acuerdo, aunque añadió que aún queda trabajo por hacer. Incluso si se llega a un acuerdo, al primer ministro Mark Carney le podría resultar difícil convencer a los canadienses y a los influyentes gobernantes de las diez provincias. Una encuesta de opinión de Léger reveló el miércoles que el 56% de los canadienses quiere que Carney no haga más concesiones. Según algunas fuentes, se espera que el acuerdo reduzca el arancel máximo sobre los vehículos fabricados en Canadá del 25% al 15% y reduzca a la mitad los gravámenes al acero y el aluminio canadienses, al 25%. Ontario, uno de los principales productores de acero y aluminio, quiere que se eliminen los aranceles. Carney está instando a las principales provincias a que revoquen su prohibición de la venta de alcohol estadounidense, lo cual supone un gran motivo de irritación para Washington.

item.title: Six killed, around 90 wounded in Russian strike on shopping centre in Ukraine
item.description: At least six people were killed and around 90 wounded on Friday when Russian drones attacked a shopping centre in the central Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, local authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least six people were killed and around 90 wounded on Friday when Russian drones attacked a shopping centre in the central Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, local authorities said. Six children were among the wounded in the daytime attack on President Volodymyr Zelenskiy's hometown, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha said on the Telegram messaging app. "Twenty-one people are in serious condition, including one child," he said. He posted a photo of black smoke billowing from a large industrial building. Zelenskiy called the attack "absolutely cynical and despicable", saying that a second Russian drone hit the shopping centre half-an-hour after the first in a deliberate attempt to target emergency services. "Attacks like these are nothing less than terrorist acts," Zelenskiy said on Telegram, urging the world to hold Russia to account. Russia is escalating its air war on Ukraine as fighting on the battlefield grinds toward the 4-1/2 year mark. On Thursday, 17 people were killed in a Russian ballistic missile attack on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Ukraine has also stepped up its own attacks on Russia, targeting oil facilities and logistics infrastructure to try to undermine Moscow's ability to wage war.

item.title: French, British, German leaders to co-chair meeting on Ukraine on Monday
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz will co-chair a meeting of the so-called Coalition of the Willing group of pro-Ukrainian countries on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French President Emmanuel Macron, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz will co-chair a meeting of the so-called Coalition of the Willing group of pro-Ukrainian countries on Monday. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy will be at the meeting in Kyiv, which will be attended both in person and remotely, Macron's office said on Friday, without specifying who will be there in person. The Ukrainian capital has come under [USN:L1N44H0GB TEXT:"heavy bombardment"] recently, and Zelenskiy has pleaded with his allies to do more to help his country. European Council President Antonio Costa will attend the meeting in person and NATO Deputy Secretary General Radmila Shekerinska will participate remotely, NATO and the EU said in separate statements. "The leaders will reiterate their determination to strengthen their support for Ukraine so that it can defend itself against Russian aggression," Macron's office said in a statement.

item.title: Monedas suben por debilidad del dólar con mercados atentos a Oriente Medio
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban ganancias el viernes, en medio de un ligero retroceso del dólar en los mercados internacionales y con los mercados atentos a la evolución de los acontecimientos en Oriente Medio que parecían estar lejos de un acuerdo e impulsaban los precios del petróleo y los temores inflacionistas.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban ganancias el viernes, en medio de un ligero retroceso del dólar en los mercados internacionales y con los mercados atentos a la evolución de los acontecimientos en Oriente Medio que parecían estar lejos de un acuerdo e impulsaban los precios del petróleo y los temores inflacionistas. * [USN:L6N44I0Q4 TEXT:"El dólar declinaba"] el viernes y parecía en camino a cerrar a la baja una semana llena de altibajos, mientras los inversores se preguntan si los esfuerzos del Tesoro estadounidense por calmar los mercados de bonos podrían acabar minando la confianza en la moneda. * Los últimos acontecimientos podrían complicar aún más las perspectivas de los mercados de divisas, donde los inversores ya se enfrentan a una serie de incertidumbres, como la guerra con Irán y la trayectoria de las tasas de interés. * En tanto, los precios del petróleo anotaban una leve alza y se encaminaban a su segunda semana seguida de ganancias, luego de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, amenazara con imponer las sanciones más duras de la historia, sin que se vislumbre un final para las interrupciones en los flujos de petróleo en Oriente Medio. * Por su parte, Irán dijo el viernes que su respuesta a cualquier amenaza de Estados Unidos sería devastadora, volviendo a encender las alarmas y puso un manto de dudas sobre un término de la guerra que libran ambos países desde hace casi seis meses. * El peso mexicano cotizaba en 16,9055 por dólar y perfilaba una quinta ganancia semanal consecutiva, tras cotizar en los últimos días por debajo de 17 unidades por dólar, cerca de niveles no vistos en más de dos años. * El avance reflejaba principalmente la debilidad global del dólar estadounidense, mientras los inversionistas evaluaban la medida de recompra de bonos del Tesoro para contener el alza de los rendimientos. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía un 0,69%, a 64.791,94 puntos, en su tercera jornada de ganancias consecutiva. * El real brasileño se apreciaba un 0,65%, a 5,1637 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo escalaba un 1,91%, a 171.132,70 puntos. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista permanecía equilibrado a 1.498,5 por dólar ARS=RASL, con una política cambiaria oficial firme para fijar el piso de la divisa en las 1.500 unidades junto a un accionar diario del banco central (BCRA). * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) ganaba un 1,9%, para recortar su pérdida semanal al 0,6%, mientras que los bonos públicos extrabursátiles subían un 0,2% en promedio, con una firme caída durante la semana del 2,3%. * "A nivel local, se mira la firmeza en las tasas en pesos (...) mientras que en el plano internacional la recompra de deuda en Estados Unidos modera temporalmente las tasas de interés de largo plazo", reportó Rava Bursátil. * El peso chileno , se valorizaba un 0,41%, a 918,40/918,70 por dólar impulsado también por un alza en los precios del cobre la mayor exportación del país. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , avanzaba un 0,97%, a 11.347,05 unidades. * Los precios del cobre subían el viernes, impulsados por la debilidad del dólar y por el compromiso de China —el principal consumidor de metales— de adoptar medidas de política fiscal para reforzar el crecimiento económico. * El peso colombiano se apreciaba un 0,96% a 3.041,37 unidades por dólar, retornando a máximos de casi 8 años; al tiempo que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) subía un 0,44% a 2.455,03 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreciaba un 0,12% a 3,3470/3,3480 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) mejoraba un fuerte 1,67% a 1.563,98 puntos.

item.title: India's downstream gas regulator approves LPG pipeline infrastructure worth $731 million
item.description: India's downstream petroleum and gas regulator said on Friday it has approved the laying of about 1,800 km of LPG pipeline infrastructure at an estimated investment of 70 billion rupees ($731.49 million).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's downstream petroleum and gas regulator said on Friday it has approved the laying of about 1,800 km of LPG pipeline infrastructure at an estimated investment of 70 billion rupees ($731.49 million). The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board said the pipelines will pass through six states: Telangana, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Karnataka and Goa. The projects have been authorised for development by India's top natural gas distributor GAIL India (GAIL.NS) , the regulator said. Upon completion, the country's common-carrier liquefied petroleum gas pipeline network will expand more than 23% to about 9,500 km. The plan reflects India's efforts to bolster energy-supply resilience as conflict in the Middle East and geopolitical risks raise concerns over fuel trade routes. India relies significantly on imported LPG, the regulator said, and the new pipelines are intended to improve the movement of supplies and the country's ability to respond effectively during supply disruptions and emergencies. The projects are also expected to reduce the movement of LPG tank trucks, improving road safety, lowering logistics costs and easing traffic congestion. ($1 = 95.6950 Indian rupees)

item.title: Watkins attracting offers as Villa continue reset under Emery
item.description: Aston Villa could lose Ollie Watkins after receiving offers for the England forward, who could become the club's latest high-profile departure, manager Unai Emery said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Aston Villa could lose Ollie Watkins after receiving offers for the England forward, who could become the club's latest high-profile departure, manager Unai Emery said on Friday. Villa's Youri Tielemans has joined Manchester United and Morgan Rogers moved to Chelsea for a British record fee, while Jadon Sancho, Douglas Luiz and Lucas Digne have also left. "We have an issue with him (Watkins), it's clear. He's a player we have offers for ... I don't want to sell him, but it can change if it is a good option for him and the club and I can replace him in the squad," Emery told reporters on Friday. "... there are still 10 days left before the transfer window closes. We will see what happens but I am happy with him and if he stays with us then he will continue at his level." Asked whether Watkins would feature in Villa's Premier League opener at Brighton & Hove Albion on Sunday, Emery said: "I don't know, maybe you have more information than us." Emery also provided an update on Villa goalkeeper Emi Martinez, whose future remains uncertain after reports that a proposed move to Juventus collapsed. However, the Spaniard stopped short of confirming whether the Argentina international had indicated a desire to remain at Villa Park amid ongoing transfer speculation. Villa have signed Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, providing additional competition and cover should Martinez leave before the transfer window closes on September 1. "We can share both. Is this scenario a bad scenario? We have two excellent goalkeepers," he said. "Martinez transmitted to us the possibility of having another challenge in his career, not just now but even last year. He was thinking that if he had the opportunity to change his challenge, then he could do it, but he stayed and performed fantastically." Despite the departures, Emery said Villa could rely on the steadfast backing of their supporters, whom he described as the club's most important asset amid a close-season of change. The club have strengthened the squad with several additions, including winger Alejandro Garnacho on loan from Chelsea, central midfielder Joao Gomes from Wolverhampton Wanderers and attacking midfielder Johan Manzambi from Freiburg. Villa have also signed right back Aaron Wan-Bissaka on a season-long loan from West Ham United.

item.title: US health department seeks public feedback on vaccine guidelines after Trump order
item.description: The U.S. health department said on Friday it was seeking public feedback on federal vaccine recommendations, including how they are categorized and communicated, after President Donald Trump's executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccinations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The U.S. health department said on Friday it was seeking public feedback on federal vaccine recommendations, including how they are categorized and communicated, after President Donald Trump's executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccinations. The Department of Health and Human Services has posted a notice asking for comments on possible revamped categories, such as whether some vaccines should be recommended but not during infancy, or recommended with qualifications. It has also sought guidance on how recommendations should address timing and sequencing, including whether vaccines could be given within broader age windows or at separate visits. Members of the public, including parents, doctors and health officials, have until September 20, to submit their comments to the health department. Trump signed an [USN:L1N4470Q7 TEXT:"executive order"] earlier this month to limit the inoculation schedule to 11 immunizations, saying it would give U.S. children "gold-standard" protection, and directed officials to review the timing and sequencing of vaccinations. The order advances a long-standing goal of Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., an anti-vaccine activist who has promoted a link between vaccines and autism that scientists have repeatedly debunked. Currently, vaccines are categorized as routine for everyone, risk-based for specific groups, or left to shared decision-making between patients and doctors. HHS is specifically seeking feedback on shared decision-making, including its potential risks such as confusion among patients and doctors, lower vaccination rates and added time for clinicians. The agency noted that public trust in federal health authorities fell during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. It cited concerns that some past recommendation processes were seen as rushed or overconfident, which hurt the overall credibility of the vaccine system. The department said the feedback would help inform its consideration of whether the current framework adequately supports scientific rigor, informed choice and public trust.

item.title: Paredes banned for 10 games after World Cup final fracas, Argentina fined
item.description: Argentina's Leandro Paredes received a 10-match suspension for his part in a brawl after his team lost to Spain in the World Cup final while teammate Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games, FIFA announced on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Argentina's Leandro Paredes received a 10-match suspension for his part in a brawl after his team lost to Spain in the [USN:L6N43L0A9 TEXT:"World Cup final"] while teammate Nahuel Molina was suspended for seven games, FIFA announced on Friday. A brief scuffle erupted at the final whistle when Argentina midfielder Paredes shoved Spain's Gavi to the ground as the European champions' substitutes rushed onto the pitch to celebrate. Paredes faced [USN:L4N43V1U3 TEXT:"three assault counts"] while Molina faced two. Both players were also fined $90,000 each. Argentina’s Thiago Almada and Spain’s Gavi faced one count each of unsporting behaviour, while Argentina's assistant coach Roberto Ayala faced one assault count. While Almada and Gavi received one-match suspensions, Ayala, who had [USN:L1N43O15D TEXT:"apologised"] for his part in the altercation, was banned for three games, with all three fined $30,000. The Argentinian Football Association (AFA) were fined a total of $321,000 for multiple disciplinary breaches during the World Cup, including the display by some players of [USN:L6N43I178 TEXT:"a banner"] declaring "Las Malvinas Son Argentinas" ("The Falklands are Argentine") following their semi-final win over England. The AFA was also ordered to play Argentina's next two home matches with spectators limited to 50% of capacity. FIFA had said using a sports event for demonstrations of a non-sporting nature was a breach of the disciplinary code. The fines were levied for breaches of the disciplinary code including use of a sports event for non-sporting demonstrations, team misconduct, and discriminatory chants and gestures by fans. "The FIFA Disciplinary Committee further determined that $100,000 of the $321,000 must be invested in a plan to combat discrimination," it said. "The implementation of part of the sanction (one of the two matches and $100,000 of the fine) is suspended, with a probationary period to apply." The decisions remain subject to appeal.

item.title: Fifa pune Argentina por faixa sobre Malvinas e Paredes por incidente na final da Copa do Mundo
item.description: A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa aplicou uma multa de 321 mil dólares à Associação de Futebol da Argentina (AFA), depois que jogadores da seleção ergueram uma faixa em referência à disputa pelas Ilhas Malvinas após vitória sobre a Inglaterra na Copa do Mundo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Comissão Disciplinar da Fifa aplicou uma multa de 321 mil dólares à Associação de Futebol da Argentina (AFA), depois que jogadores da seleção ergueram uma faixa em referência à disputa pelas Ilhas Malvinas após vitória sobre a Inglaterra na Copa do Mundo. A punição também se deve a cantos e gestos discriminatórios por parte de seus torcedores. A Comissão Disciplinar determinou, além disso, que a AFA dispute as próximas duas partidas em casa com uma restrição de 50% no número de espectadores. Também determinou punições a jogadores por incidentes ocorridos depois que a Espanha se sagrou campeã mundial ao vencer a Argentina por 1 x 0. A punição mais severa recaiu sobre o meio-campista argentino Leandro Paredes, que recebeu 10 partidas de suspensão e uma multa de 90 mil dólares. A Fifa multou e suspendeu os jogadores argentinos Nahuel Molina e Thiago Almada, bem como o auxiliar técnico da seleção, Roberto Ayala, devido aos incidentes. A Comissão também impôs uma suspensão de uma partida e uma multa de 30 mil dólares ao meio-campista espanhol Gavi por motivos disciplinares.

item.title: Reuters NEXT Gulf leadership summit to return with Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development as exclusive host city partner for next three years
item.dc:creator: Reuters Communications
item.content:encoded: Diplomatic advisor to the United Arab Emirates President Anwar Gargash speaks with Reuters Editor-in-Chief Alessandra Galloni at the Reuters NEXT Gulf Summit, in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, October 22, 2025. REUTERS/Rula Rouhana Reuters announced today that Reuters NEXT Gulf will return on October 21, 2026, bringing its definitive live leadership summit back to Abu Dhabi following the success of its inaugural event last year. The Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development will continue as the exclusive host city partner for Reuters NEXT Gulf over the next three years, building on the success of the summit's inaugural edition in 2025. "In 2025, we brought Reuters NEXT to the Gulf because the region's trajectory demands a summit equal to its ambition,” said Josh London, Head of Reuters Professional. “In 2026, that case is even stronger. At a time of uncertainty across the Middle East, Reuters NEXT Gulf will give decision-makers unfiltered access to the people moving markets, shaping policy, managing risk and investing in the future." His Excellency Ahmed Jasim Al Zaabi, Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development, said: "Abu Dhabi is a powerful convener of leaders, decision-makers, innovators, senior executives, and media. Such gatherings enable the dialogue and partnerships needed to drive investment and economic growth in a rapidly changing world. Abu Dhabi's leadership in sectors including financial services, advanced manufacturing, AI, trade, logistics, and new energy makes it a natural platform for global conversations about the future economy." Al Zaabi added "The return of Reuters NEXT Gulf reflects Abu Dhabi's growing role in shaping global economic conversations. As the emirate advances its long-term economic transformation agenda, forums such as Reuters NEXT Gulf provide an important platform to exchange ideas, strengthen partnerships and explore the opportunities that will define the next phase of global growth." The decision to bring Reuters NEXT back to Abu Dhabi follows its successful debut in 2025, which convened more than 600 senior executives from 40+ countries in the room and reached 2 million viewers worldwide via livestream. The summit delivered unparalleled access to insights from global leaders, innovators and CEOs tackling defining business and society in a region emerging as a global hub for AI, finance and innovation. More than 30 elite speakers joined the World Stage to address six core themes: Geopolitics, Economy & Markets, Banking & Finance, Technology & AI, Climate & Sustainability, and Corporate Leadership. Speakers from 2025 include: United Arab Emirates Advisor to the President H.E. Dr Anwar Mohammed Gargash Egypt's Minister of Planning, Economic Development & International Cooperation H.E. Dr. Rania Al-Mashat Nigeria's Minister of Foreign Affairs H.E. Yusuf Maitama Tuggar UAE Minister of State H.E.
